candidates.description: This feature vector represents concepts related to quantitative or qualitative changes, fluctuations, and trends over time.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to pharmaceutical drugs, medications, and related chemical substances or treatments.
This vector represents conditions, determinants, and hurdles influencing outcomes or processes.
This feature vector represents the concept of causality, influence, and having an effect or impact.
This feature vector represents biological organisms, physical systems, and systematic methods or procedures.
This feature activates on biological and cellular components, tissues, and related physiological or biochemical terms.
This vector represents frequency and temporal adverbs indicating how or when actions occur.
This vector represents comparative adjectives and adverbs indicating degree, scale, or quality.
This feature vector represents potential negative or positive outcomes, consequences, and associated costs or benefits.
This feature vector represents the concept of biological or physical resilience and susceptibility to external agents or conditions.
